caption: The drawing is a black and white line illustration on a light, off-white background. The composition depicts an ornate furniture piece, likely a secretary desk or cabinet, shown with one decorated upper door open to reveal the interior shelving. Atop the curved, elaborately crested top section is a sculpted figure of a standing person. Inside the open upper section, two shelves with scalloped or wavy edge designs display several objects that appear to be small busts or shaped items, sitting in front of a radiating shell motif. Below, the midsection has miniature arches and pillars framing small cubby holes and a few vertically stacked rectangular objects resembling books. There are also small drawers, one of which is slightly ajar. The lower part extends outward as a flat desk surface and has a detailed handle at the front. The perspective is at a slight angle, showing the depth of the open compartments and the construction details of the piece.
title: Cabinet-top Desk
